title: Source registry row
description: One row of sources.ndjson: a citable source and its rights. A cite/cites marker elsewhere in the corpus resolves to one of these by `key`.

key.description: Local registry key; the target of every cite/cites marker.

urn.description: Stable platform URN; must be directorium:source:<key>.

kind.description: text = a transcribable work; reference = consult-only; oracle = validation input (#45).

rights.description: public-domain = a title may be transcribed from it; reference = consult-only, never transcribed; oracle = validation only.
